prompts.title: Review a Swift View
prompts.content: Review the SwiftUI view below. Focus on state ownership, accessibility, and rendering performance. Return the highest-impact improvements first.

prompts.title: Turn Notes into Actions
prompts.content: Convert these meeting notes into a concise action list. Include an owner, deadline, and the next concrete step for each item.

prompts.title: Polish Product Copy
prompts.content: Rewrite the product copy in a clear, confident voice. Keep the meaning intact, remove filler, and provide one concise alternative.
